title: Prepare molecular model from crystal structure
action: Obtain the crystal structure of the [Fe4S4(SPh)4]2- anion and build two molecular models: one with natural-abundance sulfur isotopes (32S) and one with 36S isotopes substituted at the bridging sulfur positions.
description: The geometry model must be suitable for subsequent quantum chemical and force-field calculations.

title: DFT normal mode calculation
action: Perform a broken-symmetry DFT calculation on the cluster for both isotopic compositions using an appropriate exchange-correlation functional and basis set. Compute the vibrational normal-mode frequencies and Fe mode composition factors (e²) for all real normal modes. Write the results to dft_frequencies.json.
description: List of DFT-calculated vibrational frequencies and Fe mode composition factors for the two isotopomers.

title: Urey-Bradley force field normal mode analysis
action: Using the provided Urey-Bradley force constants and the geometry from the previous step, perform a normal mode analysis (GF matrix method) to compute vibrational frequencies for both isotopic compositions. Write the results to ubff_frequencies.json.
description: List of Urey-Bradley force field calculated vibrational frequencies for the two isotopomers.
